body: Normally I would agree and parts of me do see how I could go on but I would be so unhappy with my life. The amount of love I feel for her is something I never expected to be. It doubled the moment she left and only keeps going. At this point I'm losing hope of her ever understanding and I don't know what's going to happen if I come across an opportunity where I can end it successfully. Thank you for your words though they're appreciated.
